signIn.title: Platform console
signIn.helper: Staff only. You will need your authenticator app.

verify.title: Two-step verification
verify.body: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.

enrol.title: Set up two-step verification
enrol.body: Two-step verification is required for platform staff. Add this key to your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
enrol.recoveryBody: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe; they will not be shown again.

staff.title: Staff
staff.reauthBody: Enter a code from your authenticator app to continue.

notFound.message: Check the address, or go back to the home page.

siteNotFound.title: Site not found
siteNotFound.message: Check the address and try again.

error.title: Something went wrong on our side
error.message: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, contact support.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.message: This page will load when you're back online.

maintenance.title: We're making improvements
maintenance.message: The site will be back shortly. Thank you for your patience.

permission.title: You don't have access to this page

signIn.title: Sign in to {school}
signIn.helper: Use your account email and password.
signIn.joinBody: You have an account, but you are not a member of {school} yet. Join to start learning here.

signUp.title: Create your {school} account
signUp.terms: I agree to the terms and the privacy notice
signUp.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Long phrases are easy to remember and hard to guess.
signUp.closed: {school} does not accept new sign-ups. Ask the school for an invitation.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: If {email} can be used, we have sent it a link. Open it to confirm your email address. The link works for 24 hours.
checkEmail.bodyNoEmail: We have sent you a link. Open it to confirm your email address.

verify.title: Confirming your email…
verify.doneSignedIn: Your email is confirmed. Taking you to your learning…
verify.failed: This link is invalid or has expired
verify.failedBody: Sign in and ask for a new link from your account page.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.body: Enter your account email. If it has an account, we'll send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If that email has an account, a link is on its way. It works for 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password is changed. You have been signed out everywhere.

invitation.title: Join {school}
invitation.existing: Sign in with your existing password to accept.
invitation.invalid: This invitation is invalid, expired or already used.

switching.title: Opening your school…
switching.failed: We couldn't open that school. Sign in there instead.

account.title: Account
account.resent: A new link is on its way.
account.signOutEverywhereHint: Ends every session in every school, including this one.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices have been signed out.
